blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Farm Fresh forced a rubber match after dealing Nxled’s first defeat, 27-25, 21-25, 25-18, 19-25, 15-13, to inch closer to its first-ever PVL Finals in the All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday at Philsports Arena. The underdog Foxies picked the best time to end the Chameleons’ eight-game unbeaten run as they arranged a knockout semifinals match on Thursday at the same venue in Pasig City. Farm Fresh took advantage of Nxled’s costly errors in the fifth with a 10-5 start after back-to-back blocks from Ria Meneses and Mylene Paat-Rezanova on EJ Laure Cariño’s two attempts.
